name: ai-pet
description: Mac 桌面宠物 — Electron + Live2D + 语音对话
author: ai-pet

scripts.dist: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false env -u NODE_OPTIONS electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.test:parse: npx --yes tsx -e "import { parseReplyTags } from './src/shared/parseReply.ts'; const r = parseReplyTags('[emotion:happy][motion:Wave]你好'); if (r.emotion!=='happy'||r.motion!=='Wave'||r.text!=='你好') { console.error(r); process.exit(1)}; console.log('parse ok', r);"
scripts.test:intent: npx --yes tsx -e "import { matchUserIntent } from './src/shared/intentRules.ts'; import { mergeReplyWithIntent } from './src/shared/mergeReply.ts'; import { parseReplyTags } from './src/shared/parseReply.ts'; const i=matchUserIntent('请跳舞'); if(!i.matched||i.motion!=='Dance') { console.error(i); process.exit(1)}; const m=mergeReplyWithIntent(parseReplyTags('随便聊聊'), i); if(m.motion!=='Dance'||m.emotion!=='happy'){console.error(m);process.exit(1)}; console.log('intent ok', i, m);"

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: 需要麦克风权限以进行语音对话
